sumitta: [ su + mitta= mida + ta. Mida - sinehane, mijjatīti mittaṃ. Rū. 666. Sumitra - saṃ. Sumitta -prā. Addhamāgadhī. ] (thī, pu ) CL=7 (1) A good friend. (2) A monastery named Sumitta, where Lord Buddha Vipassī attained Nibbāna. (3) Sumitta, the chief disciple of Lord Buddha Siddhatta. (4) A naked ascetic (Ājīvaka) named Sumitta, offered eight fistfuls of grass to Lord Buddha Padumuttara. (5) Sumitta, a universal monarch who would become the venerable Atthasandassa. (6) Sumitta, the husband of the future therī Addakāpilānī. (7) A woman named Sumittā, would become Yasodharā.
summana: [ su + mana. Dummana - saddākiutu၍ ma-lāsañña. Sumana-pudaraṅaḥ. ] (ti) CL=7 Having a good mind.
summatthera: [ summa + thera. Suhma - sumha- summa?. Sumhanayaarapakāḥ indiyaprañña saṅgalāḥnayaanokapiuṅaḥ၌ rhisañña. Sumha-mriu့laññaḥ rhisañña. Suhma-saṃ. Vīlyaṃ. Sumha-prā.] (pu) CL=7 A thera named Summa from Dīpavihāra.
sumociya: [ su + muca + ṇe + ṇya  ] (ti) CL=7 Easy to release or easily released.
sumoha: [ su + muha + ṇa ] (pu) CL=7 With strong illusion. See - Sumohagata.
sumohagata: [ sumoha + gata ] (ti) CL=7 Being in a state of illusion.
sumucchita: [ su + muccha + ita. Mucchā jātā assāti mucchito. Apapateḥ. Su + ṅmuchita -saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 Well-arranged or well-composed with a very sweet melody.
sumuhutta: [ su + muhutta = mu + huccha + ta. Dhātuyādimhi mukārāgamo cchalopo ca. Dhāna, ṭī. 66-7. Sumuhuṅta-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 A good moment or auspicious time.
sumukha: [ su + mukha. Sobhaṇaṃ suṭṭhu mukhaṃ yassāti sumukho. Sunaddarānano. Kappadduma. Sumukha -saṃ. Sumuha - prā. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who possesses a beautiful and pleasant face. (A) Having a face as beautiful as a full moon. (B) Having a face as beautiful as gold and polished like a mirror. (2) (A) An orge named Sumukha. (B) A high-ranking royal officer named Sumukha. (C) A Brahmin commander of birds named Sumukha.
sumukhasenāpati: [ sumukha + senāpati ] (pu) CL=7 A high-ranking royal officer named Sumukha.
sumuni: [ su + muni ] (pu) CL=7 A bhikkhu who is very pure or a thoroughly pure sage.
sumutta: [ su + mutta = muca + ta. Muca mocane, to. Dhāna,ṭī. 274-5. Samukta-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Released well or Completely liberated. (Na) (2) Complete liberation.
sumuttika: [ su + mutti + ka. Thī-၌ sumattikā. ] (ti) CL=7 Released well or Completely liberated.
sumuttikā: [ su + mutta + ka + ā. Sumuttikāti sumuttā, ka - kāropadapūra - ṇamattaṃ. Therī, ṭṭha. 30. Ka- paccaññaḥkroṅa့ tta-၏ a-kiu i-pru.] (thī) CL=7 Liberated well or thoroughly released.
sumuñcita: [ su + muci + ta. Sumucchita? ] (ti) CL=7 Played (musical instruments) well.
sumāgadhā: [ su + māgadha + ā ] (thī) CL=7 (A) A lake named Sumāgadhā. (B) A river named Sumāgadhā.
sumāgadhādipada: [ sumāgadhā + ādi + pada ] (na) CL=7 The word or phrase such as sumāgadhā, and so on.
sumālinī: [ su + mālā + ī + inī. Sumālina - saṃ. ] (thī) CL=7 Having good and beautiful flowers.
sumānasa: [ su + mānasa = mana + saṇa. Moga,4.128. Sumānasa -saṃ. Sumāṇasa-prā. ] (ti) CL=7 Possessing a good mind.
sumāniya: [ su + mana + ṇya. Māna pūjāyaṃ. Rū. 389. Su + mānya-saṃ. Sumāṇia - prā. ] (ti) CL=7 Very venerable or highly revered.
sumāpaya: [ su + mā + ṇāpaya + hi. Nirutti. 454. Su+ māpa + ṇaya + hi. Nīti, dhātu. 327.] ( kā, kri ) CL=7 May you create well.
sumāpayi: [ su + mā + ṇāpaya + ī. Nirutti. 454. Su + māpa + ṇaya + ī. Nīti, dhātu. 327.] (kā,kri) CL=7 He created well.
sumāpita: [ su + māpita = māpa + ta. Nīti, dhātu. 327. ] (ti) CL=7 Well-created or established well.
